description: The New School Robotics Club: authored scenario. All rates, probabilities, valences, ages and facet percentiles are scenario assumptions, not measured values.

opportunities.situation: A teacher invites you to join the robotics club after school. You feel excited but nervous about standing out.

options.label: Accept the invitation
options.success_text: I join the club and meet a few other students who seem friendly.
options.failure_text: I join the club but feel out of place and quiet.
options.contact_text: Priya seems eager about the new club.

options.label: Politely decline
options.success_text: I decline and keep to myself, feeling safe but isolated.
options.failure_text: I decline and regret it, feeling left out.

opportunities.situation: Your father comes home late from his shift. He looks tired but asks how your day was.

options.label: Share details about school
options.success_text: I tell him about the robotics club and he listens with interest.
options.failure_text: I try to talk but he seems too tired to engage.
options.contact_text: Priya is trying to connect with me.

options.label: Stay quiet and go to bed
options.success_text: I go to bed quietly, avoiding the awkwardness.
options.failure_text: I go to bed and feel distant from my father.

opportunities.situation: Your grandmother offers advice on how to make friends, suggesting you be more outgoing.

options.label: Listen and consider her advice
options.success_text: I appreciate her concern and try to be a bit more open.
options.contact_text: Priya is taking my advice to heart.

options.label: Brush off the advice
options.success_text: I politely ignore her and keep to my own pace.
options.failure_text: I brush her off and feel guilty for being rude.

opportunities.situation: You attend a robotics club meeting. The group is working on a project and you need to contribute.

options.label: Contribute an idea
options.success_text: I share an idea and the group likes it, feeling accepted.
options.failure_text: I share an idea but it falls flat, making me feel foolish.

options.label: Observe and take notes
options.success_text: I stay quiet but learn a lot, feeling less anxious.
options.failure_text: I stay quiet and feel like an outsider.
